Single, wages $80,000, a $20,000 net operating loss from after 2017 carried into 2025. Line 8a is −$20,000, AGI $60,000, taxable income $60,000 − $15,750 = $44,250. The test: 4 × $44,250 = $177,000 is not less than $20,000, so the deduction is computed (taxable income without it, $64,250, × 80% = $51,400 ≥ $20,000).

Single, wages $65,750, a $40,000 loss carried in: taxable income after it is $25,750 − $15,750 = $10,000, and 4 × $10,000 = $40,000 equals the loss, so the test (loss more than four times taxable income) is not met and the deduction is computed; exactly at the 80% limit ($50,000 × 80% = $40,000). Pins less-than against less-or-equal.

Single, wages $40,000, a $30,000 loss carried in: after it taxable income is $10,000 − $15,750 = −$5,750, four times that is less than $30,000, so s1.nol_limit refuses at Form 1040 line 15 (the true limit, 80% of $24,250 = $19,400, is below $30,000). Line 8a itself is computed. The refused value is the evaluator's.

f1040.line15.remedy: Your net operating loss carried into 2025 is more than four times your taxable income after deducting it, so the limit of 80% of taxable income figured without the deduction may apply; figuring the limit and the loss carried to 2026 is outside this tool.

Single, wages $100,000, an $80,000 loss carried in, no HSA distribution. Schedule 1 line 8a is -$80,000, so adjusted gross income (Form 1040 line 11a) is $20,000; the standard deduction for a single filer is $15,750 (Form 1040 (2025) p. 2, margin beside lines 12e to 14), so taxable income after the deduction is $4,250, and four times that ($17,000) is less than the $80,000 carried in: s1.nol_limit (amb.2025.s1_nol_limit_test, chosen reading) is true and the tool refuses at Form 1040 line 15 (i172 p. 2: the deduction of post-2017 NOLs cannot exceed "80% of the excess (if any) of taxable income computed without regard to deductions for NOLs"; here 80% of $35,750 = $28,600 is below $80,000, so the limit does apply). Unlike x2s1o.nol.limit_refused, taxable income after the deduction is positive. The refused value is the evaluator's, after it refused at the predicted gate.
